blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After more than two weeks, the Visayas grid experienced a yellow alert on Thursday due to the unavailability of two large coal plants and limited power imports from Mindanao. Tight power supply continues, with 645.6 megawatts (MW) unavailable to the grid. READ: Red alert up for 5 hours over Visayas grid In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines said the alert status will be in place from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. Available capacity was 2,557 MW, while peak demand was 2,479 MW.
